sources.entry: Luminal - Clean, transform and analyze spreadsheets at lightspeed with AI #freemium

summary.name: Luminal
summary.one_liner: Luminal is an AI tool for cleaning, transforming and analyzing spreadsheets, though the getluminal.com page itself currently returns a generic 404 error with no product details.
summary.what_it_does: The page at getluminal.com shows a generic 404 "file not found" error and contains no product information. The only description of Luminal comes from the listing in hanishrao/collective-ai-tools, which says it cleans, transforms and analyzes spreadsheets with AI and is marked freemium. The rest of the page text is generic web hosting and WordPress .htaccess troubleshooting help unrelated to Luminal. No features beyond the listing description could be verified.
notable: Listed as an AI tool for spreadsheets in the collective-ai-tools directory
Landing page currently returns a 404 error
caveats: The page itself is a 404 error, so the product could not be verified from it
Freemium pricing comes from the directory listing, not the page
Platforms are not stated on the page; 'web' is assumed from the URL
